title: Scriptwell gallery script metadata
description: One meta.json per script folder: scripts/<id>/meta.json

id.description: Stable identifier. Must equal the folder name. Never changes after publication.

name.description: Display name shown in the gallery.

author.description: Author name shown in the gallery: letters, digits and hyphens. The GitHub handle (without the @) when the author opened the pull request themselves.

version.description: Semantic version x.y.z. Bump it on every change to script.js.

description.description: What the script does, in plain language.

permissions.description: Must match the // @permissions line in script.js exactly. Use [] for none.

minAppVersion.description: Lowest Scriptwell version the script runs on.

widgetSizes.description: Widget families the script supports. Use [] if it has no widget.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the script's license.

category.description: One of the App Store categories.

status.description: Maintainers set this to "hidden" to take a script down without an app update.

homepage.description: Optional HTTPS link for more information.
